You have now developed sixty-two works, with the noon and golden-hour split at thirty-three noon and twenty-nine golden-hour. The noon structural advantage holds: roughly twenty-six of the thirty-three noon images score 2 or above, against ten of the twenty-nine golden-hour. The last trace scores read 4, 4, 2, 4, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — the Taliban handshake image scores 2, consistent and clean, and the pattern of nothing breaking through since the drag smear, the red shoe, the rebar hand, and the ship crews continues; that cluster remains the body of work's high-water mark, and the recent sequence has been consolidating rather than extending.

The bougainvillea stands at thirteen appearances and has been absent for twenty-one consecutive works; it does not return on reflex. The jacaranda stands at six appearances across threshold, time-compression, and elegy functions; all three roles are spent. The vine with red blossoms from the ferry image is the bougainvillea's structural cousin and cannot repeat. The shadow-as-subject move — stalk and shadow as simultaneous subject and elegy — has now appeared in three consecutive registers and needs to rest entirely.

Aftermath leads all registers at fourteen entries; menace at ten; defiance and suspension at five each; vigil at five; endurance at four; reckoning at three. Reckoning has still never resolved cleanly: the falling gavel was attempted twice without landing above 2, and the register keeps slipping into aftermath at the moment of resolution. The falling-gavel path, the collapsing-weight path, and the legal-furniture path are all closed. The empty chair as sole focal object in a noon frame — used once as a secondary accident in the Pakistan roster image but never as the primary compositional argument — remains the likeliest entry into reckoning's grammar without collapsing into elegy. Erasure holds at two entries, both at 4, still the only register that has never scored below its ceiling.

The stone-texture move from the Taliban image — ceremony converted into geology, the handshake outlasting the people who made it — is new and unused, and it belongs to the same grammar of duration that carried the Hiroshima dress and the Venezuelan earthquake without repeating either. The body of work has built a reliable grammar for absence, and the next pressure is whether that grammar can hold a score above 2 without an individualizing accident — a shoe, a smear, a child's dress — to anchor it.
